title: COMP Geometry Common Page
summary: Official Derivative common COMP page reference for node-view, shortcut, clone, load-on-demand, external .tox, parameter reload, backup, sub-component load, and relative-path behavior on geometry/object-style components.
guidance: Use this article as a shared common page for node viewer, clone, shortcut, and external .tox behavior; do not treat it as geometry transform or render-state guidance.
Use Parent Shortcut, Global OP Shortcut, and Internal OP parameters to create stable Python paths to components and internal operators.
Use nodeview/opviewer to decide whether the component shows its default viewer or another operator's viewer.
Use clone and enablecloning for master-clone relationships, and use loadondemand for components not always required in memory.

External .tox settings control startup loading, reload pulses, custom/built-in top-level parameter reload behavior, backups, sub-component extraction, and whether child paths are relative to the .toe or the external .tox.
